methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $50M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Orbital Marine Power is a Growth-stage company operating in the Ocean & Maritime sector. The company has raised $50M+ to date. The comp universe for this analysis is limited: zero public comparables and one identified private peer (Ocean Infinity), reflecting the nascency and fragmentation of the frontier maritime technology space.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach given data availability. Using total capital raised ($50M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Growth-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.2x yields an implied valuation of $60M. This single-method approach produces a triangulated range of $51M (low) to $69M (high), with $60M as the median point.

The analysis supports a valuation band of $51M–$69M, centered at $60M. However, the narrow comp universe and reliance on a single valuation method introduce material uncertainty. The absence of public trading comparables precludes revenue multiple or margin-based benchmarking. The single private peer provides limited triangulation. Valuation credibility depends significantly on verification of the $50M+ raised figure and visibility into capital efficiency metrics, burn rate, and revenue trajectory. Material sensitivity exists to whether the next financing round occurs at a multiple materially above or below the assumed 1.2x step-up.
